critical.issue: master_build_packs disjoint enforcement broken: 'einfach' and 'mittel' packs share matches 'FK Kauno Zalgiris – Klaksvik' and 'Kairat Almaty – Omonia Nicosia'. User explicitly required disjoint match sets between easy and medium master packs.

action_items: Fix master_build_packs (~backend/server.py:7900) so pending 'einfach' and 'mittel' packs never share any leg.match. Current live example: both packs use Kairat Almaty vs Omonia Nicosia and FK Kauno Zalgiris vs Klaksvik simultaneously. Likely both fallback plausibility-derived packs pull from same 2-fixture candidate pool without cross-pack exclusion.
critical_code_review_comments: Master pack builder should track already-used matches per generation cycle and exclude them when picking the second-category pack, OR shuffle-and-partition available fixtures before category assignment.

notify_all_push (background_tasks.py) min_stars filter code path could not be exercised without triggering a real push; consider a unit test that patches the send function and asserts skip behavior when min_stars > tip.stars.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Only failing check is master easy/medium disjoint matches. After fix, re-run: pytest backend/tests/test_iter44_critical.py::TestMasterDisjoint -v. All other iter44 items are green. HoF is intentionally empty until server date >= 2026-08-01 — do not treat empty HoF as a bug before that date. Gift button localization verified via localStorage tj_lang=en/de/el then reload; language selector in header shows current-lang flag emoji.
rca of the issue: Master pack builder appears to build the 'einfach' and 'mittel' pending packs independently from the same available-fixtures pool (API-Football quota exhausted → plausibility fallback), so when the pool has only 2 fixtures both categories can pick both. Fix: after building the first category's pack, exclude those match keys from the candidate pool before building the second category's pack (or partition the fixture pool up-front). Reproduction: GET /api/tips?source=master&status=pending — normalize leg.match strings and intersect between einfach and mittel arrays; expect empty set, observed {'fk kauno zalgiris – klaksvik','kairat almaty – omonia nicosia'}.
